visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses sits at a round wooden table in a brightly lit white room, typing on a laptop with a large black box next to it. (2) He suddenly looks startled, shouts, and dives under the table, gripping a wooden table leg. (3) A second man in a green t-shirt and backpack bursts through a white door, shouting and gesturing urgently. (4) Both men are then seen walking along a narrow walkway inside a brightly lit, curved concrete tunnel; the man in the green shirt holds a selfie stick. (5) Night falls, and they are in a modern urban plaza with a large green Ferris wheel and a Starbucks in the background. (6) The man in the green shirt holds up a large black backpack featuring a red 'R' logo. (7) The man with glasses is seen in a sunny, green park, appearing to float over a yellow dome-shaped structure while holding a small device. (8) A wide-angle 360-degree camera effect creates a 'tiny planet' view of the park surroundings. (9) Back indoors, the man sits on a brown leather sofa talking on a smartphone, appearing frustrated. (10) A green dinosaur puppet appears on the sofa, moving its mouth as if speaking. (11) The man wakes up back at his original desk, looking stressed, and begins typing frantically on his laptop while looking at the black box.

(2) A loud metallic door creak sounds as a second energetic male voice enters, speaking rapidly. (3) Footsteps echo in a tunnel alongside a constant wind rush. (4) An upbeat electronic pop song with a synthesized drum beat and high-pitched male vocals begins playing. (5) Outdoor city ambiance with distant traffic noise blends with the BGM. (6) A digital 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a scene transition. (7) A loud digital phone ringtone interrupts the music. (8) Two male voices engage in a rapid, overlapping conversation with exaggerated emotional frustration. (9) A high-pitched, squeaky puppet voice speaks briefly. (10) A sharp gasp is followed by the sound of rapid mechanical keyboard typing and a lower-pitched narrative monologue.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Circular: Hook -> Surreal Journey -> Twist Reveal -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a surreal, comedic dream sequence to entertain the audience while cleverly setting up a promotion for a new product. By showing the creator struggling to write a script for a 'cool new product' (the Insta360 box), the video acts as a meta-advertisement that highlights the product's release through humor and creativity.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of a 'new product' at the end and clear branding on the box.
